settings.heading: How to Use
settings.content:
Spray once on your wrists and once on your neck or clothing. Let it dry naturally — don’t rub. We use a high perfume-oil concentration that helps the scent bond to your skin and last all day.

For a stronger scent, add one or two extra sprays to pulse points or hair.

Q: Are the fragrances skin-friendly?
